function.name: create_recipe_plan
function.description: Start a review-only meal basket. Ask for portions and an explicit delivery date first. Returns a job ID immediately; nothing is ordered.

preferences.description: Dietary and recipe preferences; empty string if none

recipe_url.description: Optional exact public recipe URL supplied by the buyer; do not invent one.

recipe_text.description: Optional full recipe text supplied by the buyer, including original servings. Do not invent a recipe.

planning_mode.description: quick (default) proposes an AI recipe draft for on-screen review. published researches a real recipe and can be slower. A buyer recipe link or text takes priority.

function.name: get_recipe_plan_status
function.description: Check a meal job from this same voice call. PLANNING means still working. READY means show the saved basket for on-screen review, not that it is ordered.

function.name: search_products
function.description: Search the static catalogue. Does not confirm price, stock or place orders.
